description: SNK .NET Forms - a UI-free form engine: versioned JSON form definitions, conditional show/hide/require rules, answer validation, an extensible field-type registry and designer data operations. Rendered by web (Blazor) and native (MAUI) front ends.

A pseudonymous, append-only log of the cookie consent choices a site's banner sends, for ASP.NET Core apps: an anonymous endpoint that adds each choice with the server's time, no IP address and no user agent, and a daily job that deletes old rows.

Command-line tool for packing EF Core migrations: "dotnet ef-pack pack" packs migrations into one migration and archives the originals in a zip; "dotnet ef-pack unpack" restores them. Works with EF Core 6 and later; projects reference the EfMigrationPack runtime package.

The server side of the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) for ASP.NET Core MCP servers: 402 payment challenges, settlement through Stripe or a Tempo stablecoin transfer, per tool prices held in MongoDB and the /openapi.json discovery document.
